title: Where the Grass Changes
description:
Beyond the safety of your first camp, the world changes. The next landscape may have new wildlife, unfamiliar materials and a new kind of danger.

Questlog's vanilla walking statistic is a proxy for beginning an expedition; it does not falsely claim to detect every modded biome. Explore any direction you like.

Field note: Only naturally visited, enabled biomes should count in the future Explorer's Journal.

objectives.name: Explore at least 120 blocks on foot
